stages.scope: Read applicable rules and specifications, recover relevant state, establish measurable acceptance and capability prerequisites.
stages.implement: Work in the assigned source scope using the selected procedure and approved inputs.
stages.validate: Run the mandatory technical checks and the task-specific acceptance tests.
stages.review: Diagnose failures, refine and revalidate; inspect candidate evidence and resolve required review gates.
stages.handoff: Record exact source, actual results, limitations, blockers and the next authorized action.
stages.hero-intake: Confirm identity, source hashes, authorized reference and provider permissions before submission.
stages.hero-views: Register the verified views through the installed Charakuru workflow and obtain the reference review.
stages.hero-mesh: Select the owner-reviewed Smart Mesh before segmentation, UV and texturing.
stages.hero-h1: Build and review face, hair and independent expressions.
stages.hero-h2: Build and review modular costume, wings, bow, materials, UVs and budget.
stages.hero-h3: Bind and review the rig, weights, controls, contacts and extreme poses.
stages.hero-admission: Validate exact VRM, rights, mappings, hashes and staging path; import only after admission.
stages.hero-h4: Capture and review Unity URP presentation, reduced motion and performance.
stages.asset-intake: Confirm the approved reference, route, budget, rights, identity and runtime contract.
stages.asset-build: Produce, segment, unwrap, texture, export and normalize using the applicable asset skill.
stages.asset-admission: Verify exact normalized asset, asset class, rights, Blender import, pivots, bounds and budget before Unity staging.
stages.media-intake: Confirm reference ownership, authorized provider, deliverable and per-job spending boundary.
stages.release-qualify: Collect recorded source policy, applicable qualification, final candidate and one exact-source hosted run.

local-source.description: Verify repository state, frozen migrations and release source policy.

scoped-checks.description: Record the exact commands, results and task-specific regression evidence on the candidate source. Apply applicable architecture, policy, formatting, lint, types, builds and tests.

source-review.description: Review the candidate against scoped acceptance and log unresolved findings. Identify self-review or the actual independent reviewer.

maintenance-checks.description: Run the changed tooling and governance checks, existing security scans and dependency/integrity checks as affected. Impact recommendations are advisory.

native-runtime.description: Run the locked Rust workspace tests with the qualified local toolchain.

gameplay-contract.description: Exercise applicable authority, immutable config publication/loading, binding, progression, process, restart and settlement acceptance from the task and production roadmap.

database-compat.description: Record applicable runtime and archived compatibility checks with owned disposable data; include migration plans, privileges and recovery/rollback checks for affected infrastructure.

unity-editor.description: Run licensed pinned Unity Editor tests in the candidate worktree.

unity-player.description: Capture actual built-player behavior for affected user flows. Apply named platform and performance qualification when the task requires it.

visual-evidence.description: Review actual implementation captures alongside approved references. For animated work include motion, contacts and transitions. Report observed defects and capture conditions.

visual-acceptance.description: Obtain owner acceptance for the exact visual or product candidate and artifacts.

hero-intake.description: Check H0 identity, hash, provenance and provider permissions. Run the required structural intake for the selected asset.

hero-views.description: Obtain the Charakuru reference and registered-view review before geometry.

hero-mesh.description: Obtain Smart Mesh selection before dependent processing.

h1.description: Obtain approval of face, hair and independent expression deformation.

h2.description: Obtain approval of the modular turnaround and technical budgets.

h3.description: Obtain approval of rig and extreme poses before final Unity effects.

hero-admission.description: Record the verified VRM metadata, asset SHA-256, agreed Unity import contract and granted rights.

h4.description: Obtain approval of actual Unity materials, VFX, reduced motion and runtime evidence.

asset-admission.description: Verify normalized bytes, provenance, geometry, UV, material, scale, collision and clean Blender import under the asset-specific contract.

asset-owner-admission.description: Obtain owner review before staging an asset that is part of character or Pet production.

media-provenance.description: Record the approved input, actual provider and mode, job/receipt, cost when observable, output hash and runtime use or rights status.

release-source.description: Validate the checked-in release manifest policy.

release-qualification.description: Attach exact-source hosted CI and all applicable signed, hardware, security, privacy and release acceptance evidence.

release-owner.description: Obtain the applicable owner release decision and match the canonical release policy.

repo-review.summary: Read-only repository, frozen migration and release source review

engineering.summary: Architecture, source implementation, bug fixing, refactoring, security, dependency and performance changes

native-gameplay.summary: Authoritative gameplay, combat, progression, Pet and Boss content, configuration, economy and multiplayer

database-infrastructure.summary: Database, migrations, permissions, backup/restore and infrastructure changes

unity-client.summary: Unity presentation, runtime integration, scenes, shaders, VFX, animation, visual QA and performance

hero-vrm.summary: Complete flagship and Limited S humanoid hero or key NPC with Charakuru VRM

standard-3d.summary: Standalone detached accessory, weapon, prop or environment through Tripo or eligible Meshy and Blender

standard-character-asset.summary: Standard/common Pet or detached asset for a character or Pet, with owner review before Unity staging

product-experience.summary: Visual UI/UX, website, character and Pet presentation, and player experience

media-production.summary: Reference-based visual and audio production, localization and runtime media delivery

repository-maintenance.summary: Repository governance, harness, security scanners, tools, build measurements and integrity checks

release.summary: Integration and release qualification under exact-source CI, release policy and owner authorization
